description: This source file defines the ModuleIndexes class which manages mappings between module names and makefiles, providing build and lookup functionalities as part of a toolchain related to Android development.

classes.name: ModuleIndexes
classes.description: Manages index mappings between module names and makefiles, supporting build initialization and lookup.

methods.name: ModuleIndexes
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ModuleIndexes with a specified index file.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Reads the index file and constructs mappings between module names and makefiles.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a module name and associated makefile to the internal mappings.

methods.name: getMakeFile
methods.description: Retrieves the makefile associated with a given module name.
